caption:
A short dua for forgiveness and mercy tonight

Allah Himself teaches us these words: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and you are the Best of those who show mercy. Only a few words, and they ask for everything.

Surah Al-Muminoon 23:118

Who will you include when you make this dua tonight?

#duaformercy #rabbighfir #surahmuminun #nightdua

Recitation: Mishary Alafasy
